panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: Sum of CPU requests of pods placed on the selected nodes / allocatable CPU. This is what the scheduler uses.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Sum of memory requests of pods placed on the selected nodes / allocatable memory. This is what the scheduler uses.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: CPU actually used
panels.description: Real container CPU usage / allocatable CPU.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"}))) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Memory actually used
panels.description: Real container working-set memory / allocatable memory.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"}))) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Pod slots used
panels.description: Scheduled pods / max-pods. On EKS max-pods comes from ENI limits unless prefix delegation is on. 100% = 'Too many pods'.

targets.expr: sum(count by (node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Pending pods
panels.description: Pods waiting to be scheduled or started in the selected namespaces.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Node capacity: what the scheduler sees (requests vs allocatable)
CPU requested % of allocatable, per node
panels.description: Near 100% = new pods get 'Insufficient cpu' on this node, even if real usage is low.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"}), "node_short", "$1", "node", "([^.]+).*")

panels.title: Memory requested % of allocatable, per node
panels.description: Near 100% = new pods get 'Insufficient memory' on this node, even if real usage is low.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"}), "node_short", "$1", "node", "([^.]+).*")

panels.title: Pod slots used, per node
panels.description: 100% = 'Too many pods'. Fix with bigger instances or VPC CNI prefix delegation.

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods", node=~"$node"}), "node_short", "$1", "node", "([^.]+).*")

panels.title: Node capacity detail
panels.description: 'Still requestable' is the largest request a new pod can have and still fit on that node. CPU in cores.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"}) - sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))
sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

sum by (node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"}) - sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))
count by (node) (kube_pod_info{node!="", node=~"$node"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))
sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Pending pods and what they are asking for
panels.description: Compare each request with 'still requestable' in the node table above. If no node has that much free, the pod needs a bigger node or a smaller request. Run kubectl describe on the pod for the exact reason.

targets.expr: (time() - max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_created{namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1)

sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1)

sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1)
max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Node actual load (node-exporter, includes system daemons)
Node CPU utilisation
panels.description: Real CPU busy % per node.

targets.expr: (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Node memory utilisation
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal per node. High here but low 'requested' = pods using more than they request (eviction risk).

targets.expr: (1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Pod resources (live pods in selected namespaces / nodes)
panels.description: Used/req: blue < 30% = over-requested (wasting schedulable capacity), > 100% = using more than reserved. Throttled = share of CFS periods where the CPU limit capped the container. CPU in cores.

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

((sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) / (sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace"}))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

((sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) / (sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"}))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(max by (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"}))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

(sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1))

panels.title: Top 10 pods by CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))

topk(10, (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"})) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))

panels.title: Top 10 CPU-throttled pods
panels.description: Sustained throttling = CPU limit too low. Latency bottleneck even when node CPU looks idle.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)))

panels.title: Containers closest to their memory limit (OOM risk)
panels.description: Working set / memory limit. At 100% the container gets OOMKilled.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Container restarts in the last 24h (with last termination reason)
panels.description: OOMKilled = memory limit too low or a leak. Error = application crash, check logs.

targets.expr: ((round(sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1) or on (namespace, pod, container) ((round(sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Top 10 pods: network receive
panels.description: Host-network pods are excluded because they report the whole node's traffic.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", host_network!="true"}))

panels.title: Top 10 pods: network transmit
panels.description: Host-network pods are excluded because they report the whole node's traffic.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", host_network!="true"}))

panels.title: Pod packet drops and errors
panels.description: Anything non-zero and sustained is worth investigating. Empty = healthy.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_packets_dropped_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_packets_dropped_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", host_network!="true"})) > 0

topk(10, (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))) * on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", host_network!="true"})) > 0

panels.title: Node network throughput (RX up, TX down)
panels.description: Physical NICs only (eth*/ens*). Compare against your instance type's network bandwidth.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m])) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Node network drops and errors
panels.description: Sustained drops on a node usually mean NIC saturation or queue limits.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m])) + sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

(sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m])) + sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+|ens[0-9]+|enp.*|eno.*"}[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: TCP retransmission rate by node
panels.description: Retransmitted / sent TCP segments. Above about 1% sustained points to packet loss or congestion.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(node_netstat_Tcp_RetransSegs[5m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_netstat_Tcp_OutSegs[5m]))) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Conntrack table usage by node
panels.description: When this hits 100% the kernel drops new connections. Shows up as random timeouts.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (node_nf_conntrack_entries / node_nf_conntrack_entries_limit) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
